title: Grounded AI answers with Web Search Tool and Amazon Bedrock
description: Ground AI responses in live web data using the Web Search Tool on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for model-agnostic cited answers

introBox.headline: How it works
text: A user sends a question to the Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoint.
The AWS Lambda function searches the live web via the Web Search Tool on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway using the MCP protocol with SigV4 authentication.
Web search results (titles, URLs, snippets) are formatted as context and sent to Amazon Bedrock (Claude) for inference.
Amazon Bedrock synthesizes a grounded answer with numbered citation references, returned to the user with source URLs.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
